faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP 250 G3, 255 G3, 256 G3 and the Pavilion 15-e, 15-g, 15-r, 15-n and 15-f series. The model is on the sticker under your laptop, and the part number on the back of your old keyboard (such as 749658-001 or 719853-001) is the safest check. If you're unsure, send us a photo on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this is the non-backlit version.

faqs.question: Is this a US or UK layout?
faqs.answer: This is the US English layout, and it won't match a UK layout laptop. If you're unsure which layout you have, send us a photo of your keyboard on WhatsApp.
